info.title: Converis Legacy API
info.description:
This documentation is for viewing purposes only. Therefore, no actual result is displayed even though you can click on “Try it out” button. Generating the actual URL from this documentation is not possible because it depends on the host and port, which are different for customers.
           
Legacy API provides programmatic means to read public content of Converis.

## Prerequisites 
To access the data in Converis over the web service make sure the entity, e.g. publication, has been flagged as public. The following attributes should also be set as public searchable and the input type should also be set correctly. 

• public visible 

• Status 

• createdOn 

• updatedOn

## Access and Credentials 
The URL of API has the following pattern ___https://{host}:{port}/converis/ws/___ where *{host}* is the IP or the Hostname of your Converis installation. *{port}* must be provided only if it differs from 443.

___Eg___: ___https://your_converis_system_url/converis/ws___  . Here port is not used as per request. 

The URL needs to be adapted to the Converis instance’s specific domain.

## Limits and Security 
- All requests are secured through https (secure, TLS 1.2).
